prompts: A wide-angle handheld tracking shot follows a lean young man with a square face, short buzz-cut black hair, and an old scar on his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded courier uniform with orange reflective stripes across the chest, a worn square thermal delivery box on his back, a black fingerless glove on his right hand, and an electronic scanner on his wrist. He sprints desperately down a dusk-lit street between towering sliding buildings, shouting toward a retreating concrete tower. The camera pushes from behind him to his side as he runs, then slams into a concrete wall and falls, the thermal box flying off his back. Cold, high-contrast, low-saturation cinematic lighting with deep shadows and amber dusk highlights, full shot, handheld energy.

Low-angle close-up, camera fixed at ground level looking up at a young man's face in profile. He is a lean 25-30 year old with a square jaw, short cropped black hair, and an old scar through his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded delivery uniform with orange reflective stripes and a black half-finger glove on his right hand. He lies prone on the cracked asphalt of a dim street in a towering futuristic city, panting heavily, chest rising and falling. An earpiece glows faintly. He grits his teeth, plants his gloved hand, pushes his torso up with visible strain, then reaches out and drags a worn square insulated cooler box toward himself. Cold, high-contrast, low-saturation dusk light. 832x480 landscape.

Close-up, high-angle fixed shot looking down at a street corner in a near-future dusk city, cold high-contrast low-saturation palette. A lean, square-faced man with short buzz-cut black hair, an old scar on his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded delivery uniform with orange reflective strips, a black half-finger glove on his right hand and a wrist scanner, crouches and flips open an old square insulated cooler box. Inside, instead of parcels, sit bundled sticks of dynamite and a folded paper note. His pupils contract sharply; his gloved hand trembles slightly as he reaches toward the note, paper rustling. Camera drifts subtly with his hand movement. Dusk light, gritty pavement, anxious tension.

Low-angle tracking shot, landscape 832x480. A lean young man, square face, short buzz-cut black hair, old scar on left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded delivery work jacket with orange reflective strips, an old square insulated food box on his back, black half-finger gloves, an electronic scanner on his wrist, sprints toward the base of a massive concrete building that is sliding sideways with grinding friction. He slams a block of explosive against the concrete, presses the detonator. The building cracks and shudders. He charges into the billowing smoke at the edge of the blast. Dusk light, cold high-contrast low-saturation palette, cinematic pressure.

Over-the-shoulder shot, landscape 832x480. In the foreground stands a lean 25-30-year-old man, square face, short buzz-cut black hair, an old scar through his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded delivery uniform with orange reflective strips, an old square insulated cooler bag on his back, black half-finger gloves, and an electronic scanner on his wrist. He faces a blasted-open building entrance filled with drifting smoke. The camera slowly pushes forward past his shoulder toward a flipped door sign. The sign, reading 37, flips over once to 38. The man lowers his head to a note in his hand, then lifts his head: through the smoke, countless identical silhouettes of himself run through the city streets below, backlit by a permanent dusk of cold high-contrast, low-saturation light. He exhales a bitter, stunned half-laugh.
